title: Gladly Customer
description: Schema for a Customer resource in the Gladly REST API. Customers are the unified profile that Gladly builds for every end-customer interacting with a brand across channels (voice, chat, SMS, email, social).

id.description: Gladly-assigned unique identifier for the customer.

emails.description: Email addresses associated with the customer.

phones.description: Phone numbers associated with the customer.

address.description: Postal address as a single string.

externalCustomerId.description: Identifier from an external system of record (e-commerce, CRM, etc).

customAttributes.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs the brand attaches to the customer profile.

channels.description: Channels the customer can be reached on.
